source.stem: The diagram shows a quadrilateral on a 1 cm² grid.

parts.text: Write down the mathematical name of this quadrilateral. [1]
Work out the area of this quadrilateral. Give the units of your answer. [3]

hinge.title: Decide when rearranged pieces have the same total area and compare piece areas by matching or combining pieces.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Same area is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide when rearranged pieces have the same total area and compare' is answered as same area rather than tangram.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Same area is what produces tangram, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide when rearranged pieces have the same total area.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: tangram is settled by running 'Decide when a problem asks for area and compute rectangular or square': Area is the amount of region enclosed by a closed figure; the area of a rectangle is — on the item about Decide when rearranged pieces have the same total area.

intelligence.enrichment: When the same pieces are rearranged without overlap or gaps, the total area stays the same; equal areas can be identified by placing shapes over each other or by seeing how many copies of one shape make another.
